findings.title: Gravity uses a classic frame table instead of the Guideline curve at all levels 1-20 (L1 ~283 ms/row vs 1000 ms; max one row per frame)
No perfect-clear bonus (single perfect clear scores 100 instead of 900)
No perfect-clear bonus (single perfect clear scores 100 instead of 900)
Fixed 580 px canvas overflows 390 px viewport (document width 485, hold panel at x=-95 unreachable)
Grouped scoring: no T-spin mini (mini scored as full), false T-spin plus B2B after air rotation and long hard drop, no perfect-clear bonus
Gravity capped at one row per 16 ms from level 14 (Guideline 11.4 down to 0.46 ms/row)
No buffer zone: a lock partly above the visible field ends the game
Grouped scoring: zero-line T-spins/minis score 0, mini single 100 and mini double 200, perfect-clear bonus repeats line value, air-rotated hard drop counts as spin and sets B2B
Gravity capped at one row per frame (1/60 s) from level 14
Fixed 480 px canvas cut off at 390 px (document width 435, board at x=-45 unreachable)
Grouped scoring: T-spins locked by hard drop never recognised (TSD by hard drop scores 300), no perfect-clear bonus, mini double scores 200
New pieces spawn invisibly in hidden rows (level 1: first cell visible after ~1 s, whole piece after ~2 s)
No lock-out: a piece locked entirely above the visible field leaves invisible cells and play continues
Gravity capped at 16.67 ms/row from level 14
